notes.title: "Missing Executable" PATCH (12/1/2017)
notes.content:
[quote] Today's patch (12/1/2017) fixed the "[b]Missing Executable[/b]" Error.
The problem has been completely destroyed and Lone Leader is available to play again! [/quote]
[h1] Sorry for this issue, enjoy playing! ːscaryclownː [/h1]
